title: Develop launch briefs and tiered customer changelogs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a single-page internal launch brief and a set of tiered customer-facing changelogs (developer, product, executive) for the March 2025 Console and Runtime release. Scope: - Internal one-pager (audiences: eng leads, sales leadership, support) with impact matrix, rollback criteria, and key metrics to monitor. - Customer changelogs in three tiers: Developer (detailed API/SDK/compatibility notes), Product (feature summaries and migration guidance), Executive (one-paragraph impact and recommended talking points). - Cross-team signoff loop and a gated redaction pass for any PII or security-sensitive content. Acceptance criteria: 1) Internal brief drafted and reviewed by Eng, Security, and DevRel by 2025-02-24. 2) Customer changelogs published to the docs portal in staged form (private link for beta customers) by 2025-02-27. 3) All stakeholders (Sales, Support, Solutions, Legal) have left explicit comments or approvals in the doc; no unresolved high-priority issues remain. 4) Changelogs include clear migration steps where API behavior changed, plus example snippets for the top 3 breaking changes. 5) Launch checklist entered in the Console launch board and the launch Slack channel notified with a summary card.
updates: 2025-02-18: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Security, Sales, and DevRel. Collected initial list of changes to surface; engineering owners assigned to each bullet.

2025-02-19: Drafted internal brief skeleton in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-launch-brief-2025-02-19. Included monitoring signals (latency p50/p95, error rate, token throughput) and rollback criteria for runtime-1.18 changes.
2025-02-20: Eng review (Marco Ruiz) - requested clearer wording for 'KV cache' behavior and added note about quantization fallback. Action: Leah to add technical appendix.

2025-02-21: Security review completed (Carmen Alvarez) - redaction required for an internal benchmark table containing customer IDs; removed sensitive rows. Marked security_review_required = false after remediation.
2025-02-22: Drafted three-tier changelogs (dev/product/exec) and created PR for changelog pages: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021. DevRel (Samir) added code snippets for SDK v2.3.

2025-02-23: Sales and Solutions sync: prepared talking points and FAQ for top-10 customer questions. Sales leadership (Nina Park) requested an additional one-paragraph risk summary for exec changelog.
2025-02-24: Internal brief first-pass signoff from Eng leads; opened two follow-up tickets for clarifying rollout windows (ENG-22110) and autoscale guidance (ENG-22111).
2025-02-25: Staged customer changelogs shared with pilot customers via private docs link; collected initial feedback (clarity on migration examples).
2025-02-26: Incorporated pilot feedback; final review requested from Legal (for licensing language) and Support (for escalation doc). Preparing for publish to docs portal on 2025-02-27.
Post-release note: After publish, track adoption of migration guide and number of support tickets referencing 'runtime-1.18 kv cache' for 14 days.
